Lemma
[Generalization of the Schwarz--Ahlfors--Pick lemma] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0078 1. ch28:28.46\group Finite Width

If $g_1$ is complete with $R_{g_1}\ge -c_1$, $R_{g_2}\le -c_2<0$, and $\phi $ is conformal, then $\phi ^*g_2\le (c_1/c_2)g_1$.
